text: Ok. so now scale it up. say you have 10,000 tiles. and you have 300 different effects across them at different locations, sparse. can that still blend into one quad
resolution: Scaling question answered: 10,000 tiles in one Effect quad is free — shader cost is per screen pixel, not per tile; per-tile lookup is O(1) and the data buffer is sized dynamically (effects.zig:791), 40KB for 10k tiles. The real budget is 300 DISTINCT effects: WGSL has no dynamic dispatch, so truly-unique programs need a 300-way switch (huge module, slow compile, 4x cost at blend borders). Recommended pattern: collapse to ~10-20 effect families x per-tile params in the data array, matching the hmsc shader-recipe approach; static effects can bake to textures if needed.
